text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but a gain relative to my purchase price does not mean a stock is a better sell than my other holdings.","I have repeatedly sold stocks after gains and later bought some back; with prices unpredictable, avoid treating past gains or price moves as signals about what comes next.","My loss aversion and focus on each stock’s cost basis can distort decisions, so I should weigh risk, diversification, and the portfolio as a whole rather than letting the pain of realizing a loss or pleasure of locking in a gain dominate."]}
